title: payments-service — Service Catalog Entry
body: payments-service is Acme Corp's core payments processing service, handling checkout authorization, capture, and refunds for all customer-facing storefronts. Tech lead: Priya Natarajan. On-call this week: Marcus Webb. Tier: Tier-0 (customer-impacting outage triggers immediate paging). Language/runtime: Go, deployed on GKE. Dependencies: checkout-service (upstream), ledger-service (downstream), Stripe (external processor). Related docs: the deploy and rollback runbook, and the PAY-2114 incident review. On-call escalation path: page the Engineering on-call rotation, then Priya Natarajan if unresolved after 30 minutes.
